svg.title: Live correction and required acknowledgement sequence
svg.desc: A Manager first stages replacement Resource bytes, which remain invisible. The final complete correction manifest creates a new immutable Revision and retargets only one open or paused Sitting. Candidates receive a safe ordered notice. When acknowledgement is required, each Attempt acknowledges the oldest pending Revision; protected reads and continuity continue, while Workspace mutation, terminal, governed browser navigation, and voluntary submission remain blocked until acknowledgement commits.
